text:
Alex P.: Quick heads-up — vendors pushed tentative SKUs for next quarter (H200 revA, MI300-XL, Gaudi2 pre-release). Need to align announcement windows with marketplace listing and SI handoffs.

Nina (HW Ops): Thanks. Do we have concrete dates yet? vendors gave vague 'early Q3' for H200. MI300-XL looks late Q3.

Kevin (Marketplace): Marketplace needs 6 weeks lead for images, SKU metadata, and price bands. If H200 is early Q3 we should be targeting a mid-May cutover for listings.

Marie (SI): SI onboarding requires two validation cycles (compat matrix + perf runs). That’s ~4 weeks per cycle unless we parallelize. Also need access to hotfix driver earlier.

Alex P.: Proposal: embargo window alignment meeting Thurs 10am PT. Goals: agree on public embargo windows, identify who owns marketplace artifacts, and lock SI validation milestones.

Nina (HW Ops): @Alex P. add vendors PMs to the invite. Also flag potential firmware dependency for B200 that could slip.

Kevin (Marketplace): I'll draft a timeline. Quick sketch:
```
- Week 0: Vendor finalizes binaries/WHLs
- Week 2: Redwood builds marketplace images + metadata
- Week 4: SI validation round 1
- Week 6: SI validation round 2 + marketing embargo lift
```

Marie (SI): That timeline assumes we get driver/nightly by Day 0. If driver arrives late, shift everything + extend embargo. Can we request an early driver drop?

Alex P.: I'll ask vendors for a driver freeze two business days after their binary drop. Also request a 'handshake' artifact: a signed manifest so marketplace can verify.

embargo-bot: Reminder — company embargo policy requires 72h legal review before public announcement if external partners are involved.

Kevin (Marketplace): Noted. Add legal review block between week 5 and week 6 in the timeline.

Nina (HW Ops): Action items: Alex to schedule vendor call + ask for early driver; Kevin to post marketplace asset checklist; Marie to list validation certs and perf thresholds.

Alex P.: I'll send calendar invite and ping vendor PMs now. If anyone has blackout dates for the week of May 15-22, reply here. :calendar:

Marie (SI): No blackouts. Will prepare perf test harness and a short checklist doc.

Kevin (Marketplace): One more ask — can SI confirm whether we need per-SKU pricing tiers or single SKU with dynamic pricing? affects metadata schema.

Marie (SI): Prefer per-SKU for perf parity. I'll confirm with finance on margin assumptions.

Alex P.: Great — thanks all. I'll include this thread summary in the invite. We'll aim to finalize embargo windows by EOD next Tue. :thumbsup:
